name: alert-dialog
title: Alert Dialog 确认对话框
description: 打断用户、要求确认的对话框，用于不可撤销或重要的操作。

whenToUse: 删除、覆盖、发布等不可撤销操作前确认
accessibility: 点击遮罩不会关闭，必须明确选择
responsive: 窄屏下按钮纵向排列，主操作在最下方便于拇指点击

files.content:
# Alert Dialog 设计规范

- 只用于需要用户明确确认的操作，如删除、覆盖、放弃未保存的修改；普通表单和内容用 Dialog，操作结果的通知用 Sonner。
- 必须有 `AlertDialog.Title` 和 `AlertDialog.Description`：标题直接问要做的事（“删除这个项目？”），说明写清后果以及能否撤销（检查规则 `valar/overlay-title`）。
- 必须有 `AlertDialog.Cancel`：点击遮罩不会关闭，用户只能按 Esc 或点按钮离开（检查规则 `valar/alert-dialog-cancel`）。
- 普通确认和 `appearance="confirmation"` 使用同一套 480 px 宽、12 px 圆角、20 px 内边距和透明底操作栏。丢弃草稿或删除时可通过 `focusCancel` 把初始焦点放在安全操作上。传入 `onOpenAutoFocus` 时仍可自行指定焦点。
- 对照 Linear 删除确认时可用 `appearance="danger"` 与 `variant="destructive"`。弹窗最大宽 480 px，圆角 12 px，水平留白 24 px，操作按钮高 32 px。危险按钮两主题均用 `lch(58% 73 29)`。
- 按钮文字写具体动作（“删除”“放弃修改”），不要写“确定”“是”。危险操作的 `AlertDialog.Action` 设 `variant="destructive"`；Action 和 Cancel 的尺寸只用 `size` 属性（检查规则 `valar/button-size-via-prop`）。
- `AlertDialog.Action` 的业务操作成功后通过 `bind:open` 关闭。异步操作期间可用 `loading` 阻止重复触发并保留焦点，配合文案和 Spinner。失败时保留对话框并就地提供错误原因和重试。
- 按钮放在 `AlertDialog.Footer`。普通确认把 Cancel 放在主操作前；草稿确认把次要的丢弃动作放在 Cancel 前。窄屏时按原有顺序换行。
- 简短的确认用 `<AlertDialog.Content size="sm">`；需要图标时放进 `AlertDialog.Media`，不要自己写带颜色的图标容器。
- 打开它的按钮通过 `AlertDialog.Trigger` 的 `child` snippet 渲染 Button（检查规则 `valar/trigger-child-snippet`）。

<script lang="ts">
	import { AlertDialog as AlertDialogPrimitive } from "bits-ui";
	import {
		buttonVariants,
		type ButtonVariant,
		type ButtonSize,
	} from "$UI$/button/index.js";
	import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		class: className,
		variant = "default",
		size = "default",
		loading = false,
		onclick,
		...restProps
	}: AlertDialogPrimitive.ActionProps & {
		variant?: ButtonVariant;
		size?: ButtonSize;
		/** Blocks repeat activation and retains keyboard focus while an action is pending. */
		loading?: boolean;
	} = $props();
</script>

<AlertDialogPrimitive.Action
	bind:ref
	data-slot="alert-dialog-action"
	data-variant={variant}
	class={cn(buttonVariants({ variant, size, shape: "pill" }), "min-w-0 max-w-full whitespace-normal [overflow-wrap:anywhere] dark:duration-150 data-loading:cursor-wait data-loading:pointer-events-none", className)}
	{...restProps}
	aria-busy={loading ? true : restProps["aria-busy"]}
	aria-disabled={loading ? true : restProps["aria-disabled"]}
	data-loading={loading ? "" : undefined}
	onclick={(event) => {
		if (loading || restProps["aria-disabled"] === true || restProps["aria-disabled"] === "true") {
			event.preventDefault();
			event.stopPropagation();
			return;
		}
		onclick?.(event);
	}}
/>

<script lang="ts">
	import { AlertDialog as AlertDialogPrimitive } from "bits-ui";
	import {
		buttonVariants,
		type ButtonVariant,
		type ButtonSize,
	} from "$UI$/button/index.js";
	import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		class: className,
		variant = "outline",
		size = "default",
		...restProps
	}: AlertDialogPrimitive.CancelProps & {
		variant?: ButtonVariant;
		size?: ButtonSize;
	} = $props();
</script>

<AlertDialogPrimitive.Cancel
	bind:ref
	data-slot="alert-dialog-cancel"
	data-variant={variant}
	class={cn(buttonVariants({ variant, size, shape: "pill" }), "min-w-0 max-w-full whitespace-normal [overflow-wrap:anywhere] [--valar-button-outline-base:white] dark:[--valar-button-outline-base:lch(13.861%_1.139_272)]", className)}
	{...restProps}
/>

<script lang="ts">
	import { AlertDialog as AlertDialogPrimitive } from "bits-ui";
	import { cn, type WithoutChild, type WithoutChildrenOrChild } from "$UTILS$.js";
	import AlertDialogOverlay from "./alert-dialog-overlay.svelte";
	import AlertDialogPortal from "./alert-dialog-portal.svelte";
	import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		class: className,
		size = "default",
		appearance = "default",
		focusCancel = false,
		portalProps,
		interactOutsideBehavior = "ignore",
		onOpenAutoFocus,
		...restProps
	}: WithoutChild<AlertDialogPrimitive.ContentProps> & {
		size?: "default" | "sm";
		appearance?: "default" | "confirmation" | "danger";
		/** Places initial focus on an enabled Cancel button when one is present. */
		focusCancel?: boolean;
		portalProps?: WithoutChildrenOrChild<ComponentProps<typeof AlertDialogPortal>>;
	} = $props();
</script>

<AlertDialogPortal {...portalProps}>
	<AlertDialogOverlay
		onmousedown={(event) => {
			if (interactOutsideBehavior === "ignore") event.preventDefault();
		}}
	/>
	<AlertDialogPrimitive.Content
		bind:ref
		data-slot="alert-dialog-content"
		data-size={size}
		data-appearance={appearance}
		{interactOutsideBehavior}
		class={cn(
			"data-open:animate-in data-closed:animate-out data-closed:fade-out-0 data-open:fade-in-0 data-closed:zoom-out-100 data-open:zoom-in-100 duration-100 motion-reduce:animate-none max-h-[calc(100dvh_-_2rem)] max-w-[30rem] gap-4 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain rounded-[12px] border-[0.5px] border-[color:lch(91.9%_0_282)] bg-white p-5 text-[color:lch(10%_0_282)] shadow-lg dark:border-[color:lch(22.193%_1.93_272)] dark:bg-[lch(9.232%_.85_272)] dark:text-white data-[size=sm]:max-w-xs data-[size=default]:sm:max-w-[30rem] group/alert-dialog-content fixed top-1/2 left-1/2 z-50 grid w-[calc(100%_-_2rem)] -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 outline-none",
			appearance === "danger" && "p-6 shadow-[0_9px_48px_lch(0%_0_0/.08),0_6px_24px_lch(0%_0_0/.1),0_1px_1px_lch(0%_0_0/.04)] dark:shadow-[0_4px_40px_rgb(0_0_0/.1),0_3px_20px_rgb(0_0_0/.125),0_3px_12px_rgb(0_0_0/.125),0_2px_8px_rgb(0_0_0/.125),0_1px_1px_rgb(0_0_0/.125)]",
			className
		)}
		{...restProps}
		onOpenAutoFocus={(event) => {
			onOpenAutoFocus?.(event);
			if (!focusCancel || event.defaultPrevented) return;
			const cancel = ref?.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(
				'button[data-slot="alert-dialog-cancel"]:not(:disabled,[aria-disabled="true"])'
			);
			if (!cancel) return;
			cancel.focus({ preventScroll: true });
			if (cancel === cancel.ownerDocument.activeElement) event.preventDefault();
		}}
	/>
</AlertDialogPortal>

<script lang="ts">
	import { AlertDialog as AlertDialogPrimitive } from "bits-ui";
	import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		class: className,
		...restProps
	}: AlertDialogPrimitive.DescriptionProps = $props();
</script>

<AlertDialogPrimitive.Description
	bind:ref
	data-slot="alert-dialog-description"
	class={cn("text-[15px]/[23px] font-[450] text-[color:lch(40%_1_282)] [overflow-wrap:anywhere] dark:text-[color:lch(63.304%_1.425_272)] *:[a]:underline *:[a]:underline-offset-3 *:[a]:hover:text-foreground", className)}
	{...restProps}
/>
{@render children?.()}
{@render children?.()}
{@render children?.()}

	class={cn("data-open:animate-in data-closed:animate-out data-closed:fade-out-0 data-open:fade-in-0 bg-black/25 opacity-95 duration-100 dark:bg-black/40 motion-reduce:animate-none fixed inset-0 z-50", className)}
	{...restProps}

<script lang="ts">

	let { ...restProps }: AlertDialogPrimitive.PortalProps = $props();
</script>

<AlertDialogPrimitive.Portal {...restProps} />

<script lang="ts">
	import { AlertDialog as AlertDialogPrimitive } from "bits-ui";
	import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";

	let {

		class: className,
		...restProps

<AlertDialogPrimitive.Title
	bind:ref
	data-slot="alert-dialog-title"
	class={cn("cn-font-heading text-[15px]/[23px] font-semibold [overflow-wrap:anywhere] sm:group-data-[size=default]/alert-dialog-content:group-has-data-[slot=alert-dialog-media]/alert-dialog-content:col-start-2", className)}
	{...restProps}
